senses.gloss:
--imparted to Paila by व्यास. Paila arranged it in two parts and assigned them to Indrapramati and बाष्- kala. The latter divided that into 4 शाखस् which were imparted respectively to Bodhya, अग्निमातर, पाराशरि, and याज्ञवल्क्य. But Indrapramati gave it intact to his pupil [page१-261+ ३६] माण्डुकि who taught it to his son who in his turn to his son and so on.
1: भा. 1. 4. २१; Br. II. ३४. १४-30; वा. ३२. 2; Vi. III. 4. 8, १३, १६-25.
Served as a horse for the chariot of Tripu- रारि.
2: M. १३३. ३१.
Present with पद and क्रम in वारुणि यज्ञ।
3: वा. ६५. २४.
One मात्र।
4: वा. २६. १७.
Part of विष्णु.
5: Vi. V. 1. ३७.
